_note: Festivals as weekly volume multipliers by sector, keyed to the festival's main date. ramp[i] applies to the week that ends i weeks before the festival week (index 0 = festival week). Dates verified against public calendars only where marked; others need checking before a pilot. sigma = uncertainty of the multiplier (log scale), added to the volume model's variance so festival weeks are judged loosely.
